dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: This little book is truly exceptional. The gripping plot is one thing, but the characters, wow... they're so well rounded. They really break the mold.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #I can't thank you enough for inviting me to this incredible place, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: The next time I find a good novel, I'll make sure to get a copy for you.
